item.tib: rdzi'u gnam bon rgya gar ba shes rab dgongs rgyal gyis ma 'ongs lung gi bstan pa
item.coloph: rdzi'u gnam bon rgya gar ba/ rang snyom shes rab dgongs rgyal gyis/ rang snang 'khrul pa'i rang bzhin gtam/ sman ri bla brang rtse ru bris/

item.tib: stong gsum 'khrug bcos sa snying cho ga bkra shis snying po'i sbyor ba gnyis kyi cho ga
item.coloph: rig 'dzin kun grol gsang ba rtsal gyis dpal 'bar brag nas gter du spyan drangs pa dge'o//
